items.title: Irwin Leclere Interview, 1970-04-14
items.q: I remember the name, yes. ... Kid Ross I don't remember him too well but I remember the name of Ross

ctx.x: Do you remember that contest? It's all in print, boy. Do you remember that ragtime contest? No, honestly, I don't. For Kid Ross? Do you remember Kid Ross?
I remember the name, yes. Yeah, well, Kid Ross, my brother's sporting... Yeah, that's right. Tango belt.
